name: Murder On The Horizon
source: You shouldn't know whats gonna happen. Your crush has been killed and it's up to you to find who the killer really is. And make sure they would never strike again. You can't escape the cheesiah.
translation: 你本不该知道接下来会发生什么。你暗恋的人遇害了，找出真凶的重任落在了你身上。你还必须确保凶手再也无法作案。你逃不出Cheesiah的掌心。
